messages:
Riley: Heads up 12:30pm visitor arriving with a big bouquet for a partner meeting. Courier left it at the returns shelf with no name. Where should we store it so it doesn't wilt? Also, can reception pre-print a badge for 'Riley - guest'?
Sam: Flowers  put them in the kitchenette sink with a bit of water and a rubber band around stems temporarily. If it's big, Secure Storage shelf S3 is cooler. I'll grab a vase.
Diego (reception): I can pre-print the badge. Please confirm guest name and arrival time. I'll add "escort to meeting room" on the badge.
Maya: Seating note  the low couch in the west lounge is free and visitor-friendly. If they prefer a table, the library round table has armchairs.
Chris (mail): Package scanned: "CourierCo"  12:07. Item: 1x "bouquet". Location: Returns B2. No recipient on scan. Holding for 48h before transfer to Secure Storage.
FacilitiesBot: AC set to +1C in kitchen area for 30 mins to help flower freshness (automated maintenance note).
Riley: Guest name is "Jordan Park", arriving 12:45. Thanks Sam  please vase it if you can. Diego  badge please. Maya  we'll take the west lounge couch unless they want table.
Sam: Vase done, put bouquet in fridge for 10 mins then vase on west lounge side table. Left a sticky "Jordan Park" on it.
Diego (reception): Badge queued: "Jordan Park - Riley guest - 12:45". Escort note added. I'll ring when they check in.
Riley: Perfect  really appreciate the quick help everyone :bouquet:
